run_iterative_closest_point: run the iterative_closest_point function to align two point clouds using ICP with optional scale estimation
test_corresponding_points_alignment: test the corresponding_points_alignment function to estimate rigid or similarity transformations between point clouds
apply_pcl_transformation: apply a batch of similarity or rigid transformations with rotation, translation, and scale to point clouds
generate_pcl_transformation: generate a batch of random rigid or similarity transformations with optional scale and reflection
init_point_cloud: initialize a batch of normally distributed random point clouds as tensors or Pointclouds objects
